outcome: maternal complications of pregnancy (GDM, gestational hypertension, pre-eclampsia, PROM)
perinatal outcomes (low APGAR score, fetal distress, preterm delivery, post-term delivery, SGA, LGA)
cohort: 505 pregnant women divided into three groups: euthyroid (TSH 0.3-2.4 mIU/L, n=404), subclinical hypothyroidism treated with levothyroxine with TSH 2.5-4.0 mIU/L (n=81), and subclinical hypothyroidism treated with levothyroxine with TSH 4.0-10.0 mIU/L (n=20).
finding: There was no difference in maternal and perinatal outcomes between euthyroid pregnant women and those with subclinical hypothyroidism treated with levothyroxine at TSH thresholds of 2.5-4.0 mIU/L and >4.0-10.0 mIU/L.
birth_weight: Small for gestational age (SGA) and large for gestational age (LGA) infants were documented, but specific birth weights are not given.
